name: Capture sheet and design activation
summary: Which sheet each location captures against, how a design becomes active, and how BIM models are shared down the hierarchy.

actions.action: Make a sheet the capture sheet

nfr.statement: Every location that holds captures always has exactly one capture sheet.
nfr.open_question: Should a location with captures ever be allowed to have no capture sheet, for example while its only sheet is replaced?

requirements.title: The capture sheet is chosen automatically
requirements.statement: The first usable sheet uploaded to a location becomes its capture sheet. An architectural sheet uploaded later takes over as capture sheet, and people with capture permission are told. A capture sheet that someone chose by hand is never replaced automatically. Zone sheets and internal sheets don't become the capture sheet automatically.
requirements.rationale: The PRD and code agree on the first-sheet and architectural takeover rules. Code sends a project notification when an architectural sheet arrives after other sheet types; whether it reaches exactly the people with capture permission was not traced.

requirements.title: One capture sheet per location, and what can be one
requirements.statement: A location has at most one capture sheet. Only an active sheet can be chosen as the capture sheet by hand; BIM models, DWG and DXF sheets, and zone sheets can't be capture sheets. Choosing a new capture sheet unsets the old one, including any extra ones left by concurrent uploads.

requirements.title: Changing the capture sheet is announced
requirements.statement: When an admin changes a location's capture sheet, a project notification is sent and the Track3D team is alerted. The admin may delete the old capture sheet at the same time, unless an asset category uses it.

requirements.title: A new PDF sheet goes live by itself only before any capture
requirements.statement: When a PDF sheet (not a zone sheet) finishes processing and its location has no captured realities, it becomes active straight away. Otherwise it waits for review and someone must activate it.
requirements.rationale: Whether customers or the Track3D team should review sheets for locations with captures is open (DEC-041).

requirements.title: Capture sheets and active designs can't simply be switched off
requirements.statement: The capture sheet can't be made inactive or set to error; another sheet must become the capture sheet first. On the older v1 status route, an active design can't be made inactive directly, and activating a sheet makes every other active sheet on that location inactive.

requirements.title: Child locations show their parent's BIM model
requirements.statement: When a location has no active BIM model of its own, it shows the nearest parent's active BIM model, marked as inherited. No copy of the model is stored on the child.
